synopsis: The booklet identifies AWS G6e with NVIDIA L40S GPUs as a generic pay-per-use cloud execution option, rather than an off-road-specific offering; the glossary specifies 48 GB of memory per L40S [f8370, f9257, f16202]. AWS G6e configurations scale to eight L40S GPUs, with maximum resources of 192 vCPUs, 1.536 TB RAM and 400 Gbps networking [f8854]. Third-party trackers give 2026 us-east-1 Linux on-demand prices of USD 1.861/hour for one GPU, USD 10.493/hour for four and USD 30.131/hour for eight [f8855, f8857, f8858]. The glossary also reports about USD 1.17/hour for a single L40S under a one-year commitment, while interruptible spot prices fluctuate widely [f16063]. A four-month campaign using ten GPUs of the cited AWS or Google types is estimated at roughly USD 54,000, but this is an expert estimate rather than an L40S-only configuration quote [f8312].
